title: +INTRODUCTION TO GLOBAL YOUNG ADULT LITERATURE
description: Interprets works of young adult literature within their cultural contexts from around the world, including varying definitions of adolescence. Employs critical methods to analyze literature and identify its historical, cultural, and social influences.
